text:
elaine: Heads-up: overnight we saw a cascade where cloud auth token refreshes hit rate limits in us-west2, which then caused model-registry refresh failures and a small spike in 5xx for hosted inference. Notifying owners and starting follow-up thread.

sam: saw the same. brief timeline? any impact to Dedicated customers? :eyes:

elaine: Impact: ~2.7% 5xx for ~45m, brief latency degradation for 4 Dedicated tenants. No data loss. Model registry read failures were the primary chain trigger — auth 429 -> registry retries -> downstream 500s.

priya: root cause looks like vendor auth provider returned 429 on token introspect after a policy change. They confirmed a misconfigured rate limit key on their side. We're validating whether it was config drift or an accidental rollout.

jon: replayed traces and correlated with past incidents — pattern matches the "token-storm" signature (spikes on token introspects followed by registry timeouts). This is recurring; we should treat as a class, not one-off.

marta: added customer impact notes to tracker. CS got one support ticket about retriable failures; no escalations yet.

elaine: Proposed action items: 
- Short term: increase local token cache TTL for model-registry and add jittered backoff (PR scope: bump cache from 30s -> 5m) (Prio: HIGH)
- Mid term: implement token circuit-breaker + fallback token provider + feature-flagged rollout (Prio: MED)
- Vendor actions: request SLA credit, dedicated rate-limited key, and postmortem (Prio: HIGH)
Assigning owners: priya (short term), sam (mid term), marta (vendor comms). Target dates: short term EOD+1, mid term 2w, vendor comms 72h.

priya: I can take short-term. I'll open a PR to bump token cache TTL and add jittered backoff retry logic and a metric to monitor cache hit ratio. ETA: tomorrow EOD.

sam: I'll scope circuit-breaker design and the fallback token provider (options: local minting, cached static token, or vendor-supplied backup). Need to run cost/latency tradeoffs. Prefer feature-flag rollout. ETA: 2w.

marta: I'll open vendor ticket now, request root-cause writeup and quota correction, and ask for a dedicated auth key for us. Also preparing customer comms template. ETA: 72h.

ops-bot: Added action items to incident tracker #INC-2026: https://tracker.internal/INC-2026

jon: I'll add a runbook change: detection rule for auth 429 patterns (thresholds + automated mitigation steps) and an explicit failover path for non-critical reads. Draft ETA: 4 days.

elaine: Also proposing a recurring dependency-resilience review for vendor SLAs + model-registry auth flow. @sam can you schedule a 30-min sync weekly for 1 month, then monthly? Include eng-sre, eng-platform, infra, and customer-success.

sam: will schedule weekly for the next month and send invites.

priya: will add a canary test in staging that simulates token-throttle to validate the circuit-breaker and cache changes.

marta: I'll prepare the external-facing status/update template in case communications are needed.

elaine: Summary of owners and deadlines: 
- priya: token cache TTL + jitter PR — due 2955630000
- sam: circuit-breaker design + feature-flag rollout plan — due 2956760000
- jon: runbook edit + detection rule — due 2955960000
- marta: vendor ticket + comms template — due 2955554000
We'll reconvene Friday EOD for a status check. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

priya: ack, starting work.

sam: ack.

jon: ack, will draft runbook.

marta: ack, opening ticket now.

elaine: Closing note — let's treat recurrence as a trend to track (add to monthly resilience board) and prioritize vendor hardening items in the next on-call sprint.
